definitions.gloss: price increase; raising prices; price hike
definitions.explanation: The act of increasing the price of goods, services, or wages.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{電気|でんき}{料金|りょうきん}→電気料金：26946_denkiryoukin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{値上|ねあ}げ⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Electricity rates will be raised starting next month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{原材料|げんざいりょう}→原材料：18966_genzairyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高騰|こうとう}→高騰：14647_koutou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{値上|ねあ}げ⟦せざる→する：00392_suru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}ない→得る：02014_eru⟧。
examples.english: Due to soaring raw material costs, we have no choice but to raise prices.

examples.japanese: ⟦{相次|あいつ}ぐ→相次ぐ：14869_aitsugu⟧{値上|ねあ}げ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{家計|かけい}→家計：12287_kakei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{苦|くる}しい→苦しい：02636_kurushii⟧。
examples.english: Successive price increases are straining our household budget.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{値|ね}→値：03527_ne⟧ (price, value) + {上|あ}げ (raising, from ⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧)

FORMS:
{値上|ねあ}げ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ - to raise prices (transitive suru-verb)
{値上|ねあ}げ⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧ - prices are raised (passive)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {値上|ねあ}げ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}する→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧ - to announce a price increase
- {値上|ねあ}げ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{踏|ふ}み{切|き}る→踏み切る：06237_fumikiru⟧ - to decide on a price increase
- {値上|ねあ}げ⟦{幅|はば}→幅：03565_haba⟧ - amount of price increase
- {値上|ねあ}げ⟦ラッシュ→ラッシュ：11221_rasshu⟧ - wave of price increases

USAGE:
- ⟦{物価|ぶっか}→物価：03607_bukka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{値上|ねあ}げ - price increases of goods
- ⟦{賃金|ちんぎん}→賃金：04842_chingin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{値上|ねあ}げ - wage increase
- ⟦{家賃|やちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{値上|ねあ}げ - rent increase

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{値下|ねさ}げ→値下げ：07583_nesage⟧ - price reduction
